name: Quebec

plates.name: Veteran’s Licence Plate
plates.fact: Its design shows a poppy, a poppy field and two soldiers in profile, one man and one woman, with the word “vétérans”.

plates.name: Green personalized licence plate (electric passenger vehicle)
plates.fact: Only electric vehicles can get the green version of Quebec's personalized plate.
